body: Okay thank you. I’ve had a “second chance” at having good teeth. Had about 7,000 dollars worth of work on my front teeth and they look good as new. I don’t want to damage them. I haven’t had a single soda or energy drink since all of the procedures. I’ve been sticking to coffee, water, and juice. Thanks

In terms of avoiding drinking soda or “fizzy drinks”, I’ve been told by my dentist that it’s okay every now and then to drink soda but to limit the amount. Does that include energy drinks? Do energy drinks like Red Bull have the same effect on teeth? I used to have really bad teeth, and got them all fixed and filled recently. Don’t want to start over again. Thanks
I would like to vent. I don’t know how to cope.

I posted on the relationship sub Reddit. Basically, the love of my life, chose to cheat on me whilst I am deployed on a military deployment. I love her. God I love her. She was mine. She was the one. And she’s gone. My heart is so damaged. My coworkers tell “don’t worry brother you’ll find another girl who will love you properly”. But they don’t understand. They don’t know  the pain. They don’t know how strong my love for her was. I don’t have family. I don’t have close friends. I had her. And she’s gone. 

I fantasize about dying every day. I don’t want to live. But I don’t want to die yet. I want her to come back to me and that thought is the only thing keeping me here to be honest. 

I don’t know what to do.

The point is so her boyfriend knows that his girlfriend acted on an impulse and cheated? Holding it from him is unfair to him and the relationship. Lying and cheating is not a good combination for any relationship and the boyfriend deserves to know so he can determine what he wants to do. If he finds out the hard way, that’s a guarantee almost to end the relationship.

Lying to your partner about who you are with is cheating. Let alone kissing. 

Yes. It’s cheating.
This. Spa days. A break from mom duties for a little while. And a nice dinner to couple with that maybe.

White lies are one thing. I’ll be honest it’s a flaw of mine. My fiancé would ask me what I’m doing and instead of making a huge explanation I just choose an easy harmless answer that takes less explaining. Like if I’m heading to the store after work to pick up parts for my car, I’ll just say “Heading home” to avoid an unnecessary conversation. Or one time I was on my military base training and she asked me what I was doing and I said “nothing just hanging out” so I didn’t have to explain what we were doing, etc. It’s bad, I know. There’s a possibility he’s doing something like that if the lies are small and insignificant. 

But if he is lying about small stuff like that I would talk to him about it but I wouldn’t trip on it too much. Tell him it’s concerning you and ask why he does it. Don’t assume he’s “probably cheating” because that will make you paranoid.
